requirement.original: Fix MCP title change failure -- the STDIO bridge cannot connect to the HTTP MCP server, causing change_title to fail every time
requirement.clarified: The mcp__happy__change_title tool fails every time because the pretool-workflow-gate.py PreToolUse hook blocks it before the call reaches the STDIO bridge. The bridge and HTTP MCP server are working correctly. Additionally, revert incorrect overnight changes to knownTools.tsx and messageToEvent.ts.
requirement.what: Exempt mcp__happy__change_title from the workflow gate hook; revert overnight UI changes to knownTools.tsx and messageToEvent.ts
requirement.why: Title changes fail 100% of the time in sessions with active workflows, which is most sessions. The tool is infrastructure, not a dev tool, and should not be subject to workflow gating.

Revert knownTools.tsx to pre-overnight state (restore hidden:true, minimal:true, noStatus:true)

excluded: No changes to HTTP MCP server (startHappyServer.ts)

success_criteria: mcp__happy__change_title tool call succeeds when workflow is active

Other tools still blocked by workflow gate when TodoWrite not acknowledged
constraints: Hook file is global (~/.claude/hooks/), not project-specific
The hook has no matcher in settings.json -- it runs on ALL tools
Must not weaken workflow enforcement for actual dev tools

root_cause_analysis.symptom: mcp__happy__change_title fails every time with 'PreToolUse:mcp__happy__change_title hook error'
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The pretool-workflow-gate.py global PreToolUse hook blocks mcp__happy__change_title when there is an active workflow bookmark and TodoWrite has not been acknowledged. The hook only exempts TodoWrite and TodoRead but not MCP infrastructure tools.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - hook was introduced around 2026-03-16, not tracked in this repo
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The workflow gate was designed to enforce checklist discipline: agents must acknowledge their todo list before using other tools
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: mcp__happy__change_title is an infrastructure/utility tool (changes session title), not a dev tool. It should be exempt from workflow enforcement like TodoWrite/TodoRead. Most sessions have active workflows, so title changes fail nearly 100% of the time.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Before March 16: 100% success. March 16+: intermittent failures (depends on workflow state). Current: fails in most sessions.
